info.name: FBLabs SD Mapper V2 with the m6 kernel ROM, the m6 block device and a mapper, two cards
info.description: The SD Mapper V2 cartridge with the m6 kernel ROM (build/m6-sdmapper.rom, copied into the ROM pool by the harness; no checksum, the ROM changes with every build) presenting the m6 block device's registers in bank 7 beside its own, with a 432K memory mapper of its own in subslot 3 that the block's Turbo commands write into — the shape of a cartridge that is itself the machine's memory mapper; two cards: card 1 the image given with -hda, an SDHC card; card 2 the image given to the hdb command, a standard-capacity (SDSC) card addressed by byte.
